brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: Seed-starting tray of at least four cells
requirements.evidence: Four full bases (piece:0,0,0, piece:1,0,0, piece:0,1,0, piece:1,-1,0) form a 2x2 cluster, one cell each, filled with soil and planted with seedlings (prop:1–prop:4).

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: Each of the four cells holds a hex-bin-full-drain bin (bin:0,0,0, bin:1,0,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:1,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain), the catalog's drained full-depth bin.

finish.summary: A 2x2 Hex Cluster seed-starting tray: four full bases, each fitted with a full-depth drained bin (hex-bin-full-drain), capped on open faces and joint-locked per house rules, then filled with soil and planted with seedlings to show it in use. check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
